challenge.method: Compare explicit declarations with inference of a type after declaration, the compatibility mode descriptions and source-selected dialect directives. Inspect a pinned fragment using explicit variables without treating it as a conformance test.
challenge.results: The explicit declaration rule is documented for default fb and accepts the named declaration forms. Type inference after an explicit declaration is a distinct issue and other dialect modes retain separate rules.

limitations: The proposition is confined to the documented fb dialect in the exact 1.10.1 source tree.
